gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.t: Ascension quest "The One Who Witnesses the Nightmare"
gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.i: The next one, "The One Who Swears the Oath", is recommended Lv 49, past this guide, so expect it to need gear.

gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.s: Open the Cube, click the old piece, choose Extract and confirm.
gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.i: Only gear in your Cube can be extracted, not what you're wearing, so the option appears once a drop replaces something.

gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.s: The main story hands it to you around Lv 13 (it can't be missed).
gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.i: Enhance it +1 each time you get a Noble Belt Enhance Scroll (2 per Stronghold, see Dungeons & Strongholds). Each +1 also costs Enhance Stones and Kina; success is 100%.

gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.s: The story gives it at Lv 16, just before the Monolith quest.
gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.i: Every Monolith level from 2 gives a Revelation Amulet Enhance Scroll ; use each one right away (+1, plus Enhance Stones and Kina). The belt to +10 (Rare) costs 232,000 Kina and 9,280 Enhance Stones. Substance Morph then moves it up a rarity tier.

gladiator/L45-q86-none-A.s: Use all your Daevanion Crystals in your Cube, then buy its nodes from the Daevanion board card at the top.
Use all your Daevanion Crystals in your Cube, then buy its nodes from the Daevanion board card at the top.
